title: CatalogIQ
problem: Enterprises drown in messy, inconsistent product-catalog data across suppliers — mismatched brands, duplicates, and missing attributes make it unusable for search, analytics, or storefronts.
solution: A 10-stage pipeline — ingest, clean, brand-resolve, AI-extract, classify, dedup, validate, human-review — behind a FastAPI control plane with a Streamlit ops dashboard and Prometheus monitoring. LLM extraction is schema-validated with a human-in-the-loop review gate before anything is trusted.
outcome: TODO: add a measurable result (e.g. cut catalog cleanup from days to minutes; NN% attribute-extraction accuracy at review).
role: Solo architect & engineer — pipeline design, schema-validated AI extraction, FastAPI + Streamlit, observability.

title: NexGuard
problem: SOC teams face alert fatigue and opaque detections, and sending sensitive logs to a third-party cloud is a non-starter for many organizations.
solution: Layered anomaly detection — DeepLog LSTM + Isolation Forest + an ensemble — with explainable alerts, a verified local-LLM incident-triage step, and a real-time SOC console. Runs fully local to stay privacy-preserving.
outcome: TODO: add a measurable result (e.g. NN% reduction in false positives; sub-second detection latency).
role: Solo architect & engineer — detection models, local-LLM triage, real-time console (Python + TypeScript).

title: Jarvis
problem: Cloud voice assistants are privacy-invasive, hard to extend, and can't safely touch your actual desktop, files, or workflows.
solution: A local-first Windows assistant — an async, event-driven, plugin-based Python backend paired with a Tauri/React UI. Wake-word activation, streaming STT/TTS, long-term memory, OS automation, multi-agent orchestration, and vision.
outcome: TODO: add a measurable result (e.g. NN plugins; end-to-end voice latency; tasks automated).
role: Solo architect & engineer — agent orchestration, plugin system, Tauri/React UI, STT/TTS pipeline.
